eyebrow: A 95% CI for mean delivery time
code:
xbar = sample.mean()    # 39.62
se = stats.sem(sample)  # 0.863
tcrit = stats.t.ppf(0.975, 39)
# 2.023
xbar - tcrit*se, xbar + tcrit*se
# 37.87  41.37
caption: Illustrative simulated deliveries (n = 40).

code:
hits = 0
for _ in range(2000):
    smp = rng.choice(pop, 40,
                     replace=False)
    l, h = stats.t.interval(0.95, 39,
        loc=smp.mean(),
        scale=stats.sem(smp))
    hits += (l <= pop.mean() <= h)
# hits / 2000 = 0.9475
caption: About 95% of intervals catch the truth. Each one either does or doesn't.
